pages.text:
The Arc Drill is a pickaxe and shovel in one; the Arc Saw is an axe. They never break, but they run on FE. Charge them in an Energy Cell or any Battery slot.
| Tier | FE | Mines | Speed | Modules |
| Tempered | 100,000 | Diamond | 8 | 2 |
| Hardened | 400,000 | Netherite | 10 | 3 |
| Arcforged | 1,600,000 | Netherite | 14 | 4 |
Each block costs about 50 FE, more for hard blocks (stone 69 FE, obsidian 675 FE). With no FE left the tool can't mine.

# Modules
Right-click in the air to open the tool and drop module cards into its slots. Sneak + scroll switches modules on and off; the action bar shows which are on. Each active module adds to the FE per block.
- **Area** (+25%): 3×3 facing the side you hit, 5×5 on Arcforged. Same rules as the Steel Hammer.
- **Silk Touch** (+100%)
- **Fortune I / II / III** (+50% / +100% / +150%). Only one of Silk Touch or Fortune is on at a time.
- **Vein Mining** (+25%): the Drill takes up to 64 connected blocks of the ore you hit; the Saw's Felling mode takes the whole tree.
- **Speed** (+50%): digs 50% faster.

# Felling
Sneak + right-click the Arc Saw to toggle Felling mode. With it on, cutting a log also cuts up to 32 connected logs above and around it; with a Vein Mining module it takes the whole tree (up to 256). Every log costs FE.
